purpose: Replace packed-pattern raster parsing with an AlphaGeometry-inspired neural proposer plus deterministic sewing-pattern verifier.

neural_proposer.architecture: cyclic edge Transformer inside a garment-level panel Transformer

hard_geometry_facts: each panel is one closed boundary cycle
every boundary point has degree two
NEXT and SHARED_ENDPOINT agree with edge incidence
every selected seam edge has degree at most one
projection: landmark derivation only at a shared source vertex
soft_not_hard: sewn edge lengths must be identical
every GCDv2 panel must follow one canonical expert drafting order

evaluation.split: garment-ID-disjoint 80/10/10 using the GCDv2 neurosymbolic split authority
metrics: seam pair precision/recall/F1 and mate recall@1

four_view_alignment.pattern_input: frozen coordinate-free Pattern DSL panel tokens
four_view_alignment.training: bidirectional InfoNCE plus low-weight category auxiliary loss
four_view_alignment.output: ranked train-bank DSL anchors followed by the same symbolic verifier
four_view_alignment.forbidden_interpretation: symbolic validity of a retrieved anchor is not proof that it equals the held-out target pattern

symbolic_candidate_beam.proposal_facts: neural edge roles and seam scores
symbolic_candidate_beam.hard_checks: cyclic role grammar, symmetric one-mate seam matching, shared-vertex landmark deduction
symbolic_candidate_beam.result: exact primitive topology top-1 remained 17.68%; top-10 coverage was 50.00%

svg_compiler.output: native analytic SVG M/L/Q/C/A/Z with non-overlapping panel layout
svg_compiler.default_metadata: leakage-safe geometry and verification summary only
svg_compiler.debug_overlays: semantic roles, derived landmarks, predicted seam proofs, and provenance are explicit opt-ins

claim_boundary: This stage starts from exact GCDv2 vector geometry, not photographs or panel raster images.
Semantic labels are generator/topology-derived and are not yet expert cross-source truth.
The design is AlphaGeometry-inspired; it is not a reproduction of AlphaGeometry or a general theorem prover.
The implemented 4-view bridge retrieves existing DSL anchors; direct target command/edit generation remains a separate stage.
Any later target-specific 4-view generator must emit the same DSL and pass this verifier before pattern materialization.
